assumption.description: DefaultHasher provides good distribution for Bloom filter
assumption.rationale: Rust std lib DefaultHasher is SipHash (cryptographic quality hash function)

verification.method: Property test: 10,000 unseen documents, FPR < 0.1% (test_bloom_false_positive_rate)

assumption.description: Relaxed ordering sufficient for Bloom filter bit array updates
assumption.rationale: False positives are acceptable, no happens-before required. Bit setting is monotonic (never clears).

verification.method: Code inspection: BloomFilterCapsule uses fetch_or(Relaxed) for bit setting
Stress test: 16 threads, 160,000 concurrent inserts (verify_no_deadlocks_lockfree)
verification.result: Zero deadlocks, zero data corruption, all operations complete

assumption.rationale: 99.92% recall still exceeds LSH target (92-99% recall). 0.08% loss acceptable for 2-10× speedup.

verification.method: Mathematical: Recall = (1 - FPR) × LSH_Recall = 0.9992 × 0.95 = 94.9%
Property test: Skip rate on 90% duplicate corpus (test_bloom_skip_rate_duplicate_heavy)

assumption.description: No TOCTOU race in Bloom filter (fetch_or is atomic, non-CAS)
assumption.rationale: fetch_or completes atomically, no read-modify-write gap. No CAS loops = no ABA risk.

verification.method: Code inspection: insert() uses fetch_or (not CAS), query() uses load (read-only)
Stress test: 8 threads, 40,000 interleaved operations (verify_no_aba_problems)

assumption.description: BloomFilterCapsule is Send + Sync (safe for concurrent access)
assumption.rationale: All mutations via AtomicU64, no raw pointers to thread-local data

verification.method: Type system validation: Arc<BloomFilterCapsule> compiles (requires Send + Sync)
16-thread stress test validates concurrent access safety

race.description: Concurrent Bloom filter bit array updates
race.verification: Stress test with 16 threads validates zero corruption

race.mitigation: Query is read-only (Relaxed load), insert is atomic (fetch_or). False positives acceptable.
race.verification: Property test validates FPR < 0.1% under contention

performance-validation.insert-latency: < 50ns per document (7 atomic fetch_or operations per shard)

assumption.description: Relaxed ordering sufficient for progress counter updates
assumption.rationale: Approximate progress is acceptable for dashboard display. Final count verified after completion.

verification.method: Unit test: verify final count equals total docs (test validates eventual consistency)

assumption.description: ParallelDedupPipeline is Send (but not Sync) - sequential API wrapper
assumption.rationale: Pipeline owns signatures Vec (not thread-safe), but can be transferred between threads

verification.method: Type system validation: ParallelDedupPipeline: Send (compiles), not Sync (correct)
API design: add_document(&mut self) enforces single-threaded access per instance

assumption.description: No races in parallel document processing (disjoint doc_id ranges)
assumption.rationale: Each thread processes unique doc_id range, no shared state beyond atomic counters

verification.method: Code inspection: add_documents() assigns disjoint ranges to ThreadPool workers
Stress test: 16 threads, 100K documents, verify zero duplicates in result

assumption.description: No TOCTOU in parallel signature storage (Vec indexing with bounds check)
assumption.rationale: signatures[doc_id] uses bounds-checked indexing, doc_id uniqueness guaranteed by design

verification.method: Type system: Vec indexing panics on out-of-bounds (fail-fast safety)
Unit test: doc_id >= capacity triggers PipelineError (graceful error handling)

assumption.description: ThreadPool creation succeeds with valid thread count
assumption.rationale: ThreadPool::new() validated by atomic_capsule, errors propagated via Result

verification.method: Error propagation: ThreadPool::new() errors mapped to PipelineError
Unit test: new() with invalid thread count returns Err (graceful failure)

assumption.description: LockfreeResultAggregator provides correct parallel result aggregation
assumption.rationale: LockfreeResultAggregator validated in atomic_capsule Phase 15 (688+ tests, 100% lockfree)

race.verification: Code inspection: ThreadPool assigns non-overlapping work units
